notes_for_editor: This is the Idaho County Little Baldy (45.93654, -115.68354). Do not merge it with us-id-little-baldy: Idaho Fire Lookouts' cda-region Little Baldy is a different site (1920 camp, 1940 20-foot pole L-4 tower on West point, destroyed 1970), and the Fire Lookout Association lists a Shoshone County Little Baldy as well. A Forest Lookouts (weebly) page for Little Baldy describes a 1930s tent camp; I did not confirm whether it is this site, so it is left out. The Nez Perce list's Status column reads 'abandoned' with 1950 on the row's second line (read from the PDF table layout); the 1940s entry is in its Photos column, so it is not the abandonment date. The 1950 date conflicts with the 1959 standing and 1963 gone in the other two sources. The story reports both and does not choose between them; the editor should check the PDF row. No source gives staffing for this site.
